results.name: limousine-and-taxi-licence-values-queensland
results.notes:
This dataset contains Queensland's limousine and taxi service licence values, including licence type, transfer values and locations. 

The information published in this register includes transfer prices of taxi service licences and limousine licences. In December 2024 a complete review was undertaken to remove duplicate entries and anomalies to ensure data integrity and accuracy. Please disregard all previous versions.

The figures reflect the value of the licence only and do not include other costs associated with the sale, such as shares or vehicle costs. 

The values may not always reflect ‘arms length’ transactions. For example, some transfers may be the result of a sale of partnership or organisational name change. In instances where a licence is transferred as a result of a business name change or a deceased estate, the licence value reflected in the register may be zero. In the case of taxi service licences, where the value of a licence transfer appears lower than average for that period, it may be the case that there were special conditions (for example – an owner/driver condition) imposed upon the licence at that time. 

The Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR) plays no part in commercial transactions between private parties and does not determine the market value of any taxi service licence or limousine licence. 

The information published in this register is public information. Further enquiries about the information must be directed to [The Department of Transport and Main Roads Right to Information Unit.](https://www.tmr.qld.gov.au/About-us/Right-to-Information) In accordance with relevant privacy laws, TMR is unable to disclose personal details about any transaction unless required to do so by law.

QGC Pty Limited (QGC) was granted Petroleum Survey Licence (PSL) 2047 for two years effective from 29 April 2020. The purpose was to enable off-tenure ground investigations of a potential point-to-point gas pipeline, from Petroleum Lease (PL) 179 to tie into the field gathering system situated on PL 180, to allow production to continue in the event of a Field Compressor Station shutdown. A pipeline route successfully identified in this PSL area would provide the locational basis for a future application for a pipeline licence under the Petroleum and Gas (Production and Safety) Act 2004.
The area of PSL 2047 covers only part of PL 226 held solely by Australia Pacific LNG Pty Limited, which is located between PL 179 and PL 180, as shown on Figure 1. PSL 2047 covers one sub-block of approximately 3km², BIM Block Sub-block BRIS 2453 Z
The survey and ground truthing for an off-tenure pipeline route was successfully completed and found to support the application for a pipeline licence. Pipeline Licence (PPL) 2063 was applied for and granted on 10 June 2021.
As a result of the grant of PPL 2063, PSL 2047 became redundant, therefore, QGC made application for the surrender of PSL 2047 on 19 July 2021, which was approved and effective from 18 August 2021. QGC also made application for full surrender of PSL 2047’s environmental authority EA00022556, received by the administering authority on 19 July 2021 and approved on 5 August 2021.

Continental Copper Pty Ltd (Continental Copper) holds EPM 27827 covering 206.3km2, the Rose Green Project, 73km NW of Cloncurry in the Mt Isa inlier.  The Mt Isa inlier is the premier Zn-Pb-Cu region in the world with the Mt Isa deposit in the Western Fold Belt hosting 150Mt at 7%Zn, 6%Pb and 150 g/t Ag and 421Mt at 1.6% Cu and Cannington reporting 44Mt at 11% Pb, 4.4% Zn and 540 g/t Ag in the Eastern Fold Belt. Increasingly the inlier has become the focus of Cu-Au exploration following the discovery of the 254 Mt 1.1% Cu and 0.6 g/t Au, Ernest Henry deposit, undercover to the south of Continental Copper acreage.  

The Mt Isa Inlier comprises a central Kalkadoon-Leichhardt basement block flanked by the Eastern and Western fold belts (Hutton, Denaro, Dhnaram, & and Derrick, 2012). EPM 27827 lies within the Eastern Fold Belt to the east of the large Dugald River Pb-Zn and to the NW of the Ernest Henry IOCG, Cu-Au deposits.  

This report is a review of all available exploration, geophysical and research data.

There is no outcrop within EPM 27827.  There has been significant metal exploration including 28 percussion drill holes totaling 3,828 metres and airborne and ground magnetics, gravity and EM.

Following a review of the available data, the licence would appear to offer little potential with only drillhole BMP005 on the eastern boundary of the licence area showing anomalous copper.  This anomalous sample was within a sand of likely Mesozoic age at the contact with Proterozoic basement, which was not mineralized.

It is recommended that the licence be surrendered.
results.title: EPM27827 ROSE GREEN FINAL REPORT FOR PERIOD ENDING 20 OCTOBER 2022

This is the eighth and final report for EPM 25530 Dulhunty East since the tenement was granted by Rio Tinto Exploration (RTX) on 27 May 2015. EPM 25530 Dulhunty East is a 29 sub-block licence located approximately 100km northeast of Weipa and lays adjacent to the Rio Tinto held mining lease ML 7031. 

During this reporting period from 27 May 2022 to 26 May 2023, no field activities were carried out within the tenement.

Following the tenement being granted on 27 May 2015, RTX have completed reconnaissance mapping along transects, rock chip sampling and hand auger drilling to test for the presence of bauxite. This work confirmed the presence of bauxite in isolated areas with most areas revealing an ironstone horizon beneath a 
thin overburden. Due to internal reprioritisation of projects and the expiration of the land access agreements with the Apudthama Land Trust in 2020, the tenement is being relinquished in full.
results.title: EPM25530 DULHUNTY EAST FINAL REPORT FOR PERIOD ENDING 26 MAY 2023

This final report describes the exploration activities carried out by FMG Resources Pty Ltd on EPM 27852 between 14 December 2021 and 5 July 2024. FMG Resources Pty Ltd is a subsidiary 
of Fortescue Ltd, an Australian minerals company based in Western Australia, which is currently exploring for critical minerals in northern Queensland. 
 
Exploration completed on EMP 27852 throughout the life of the licence comprised a historical data review, geological mapping, surface sampling and native title party engagement. All activities had a primary focus on the geochemical characteristics of the area and how it compares to analogous targets. Unfortunately, the results were poor. While the Featherbed ignimbrites are likely to be of the same family as the target type, concentrations of vector elements that are indicative of potential mineralisation are limited to isolated points with no continuity across sampled areas. Furthermore, indicative concentrations are typically limited to very similar elements suggesting the correlation is related to rock family rather than mineral enrichment. 

EPM 27852 was voluntarily relinquished in full on 5 July 2024.
results.title: EPM27852 FEATHERBED FINAL REPORT FOR PERIOD ENDING 05 JULY 2024

This report summarises work undertaken by Khalkeus Pty Ltd on EPM 25952 from the grant of tenure to the end of term when the tenement expired on 28/02/2021. This tenement was selected to evaluate the potential of dolomite deposits for use as an agricultural industrial mineral. Work conducted during the term of the tenure included reconnaissance field evaluation, rock chip geochemistry, reverse circulation drilling, and pitting. The programs indicated that the tenement hosts a significant quantity of carbonate rock. Further evaluation is required to confirm the exact quantities of high-quality magnesian dolomite. Plans were made to take a bulk sample, but stalled when the landowner requested the sampling be deferred due to a planned sale to the property. Efforts were made to seek a strategic partner to support the next level of investment in evaluation. Whilst various parties found the project to be of technical interest, industrial mineral companies were generally found to be looking for a more advanced projects. With the advent of the COVID-19 pandemic, the decision was made to discontinue the project and let the licence expire.
results.title: EPM25952 MAGENTA FINAL REPORT FOR PERIOD ENDING 28 FEBRUARY 2021
